title: Feature: Airtable-style Floating Chatbot (FAB Widget)
body: ## Summary Implement a floating chatbot widget (FAB style), inspired by Airtable, for ObjectUI. This feature will enable users to access the chatbot from any page via a floating button (FAB), which expands into a chat panel overlay when clicked. ## Background - The current chatbot in `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` is only available as an inline, embedded component. - Modern enterprise UIs like Airtable offer a floating, context-aware chatbot that does not occupy dashboard or main content areas, improving UX and discoverability. ([See reference screenshot below]) ## Requirements - Floating action button (FAB) fixed to bottom-right (configurable position) - FAB opens a panel with the full chatbot UI (`ChatbotEnhanced`) - Panel supports drag, collapse, close, and fullscreen - Configurable: default open/closed, position (bottom-right/left), width/height, trigger icon - Panel header supports conversation title, history, fullscreen toggle, close button - Integrates with ObjectUI's context (current object/view/data) for prompt injection - Demo mode and AI streaming modes must both work - Schema-driven: enable via `displayMode: 'floating'` in schema - Fully compatible with component registry (`type: 'chatbot'`) - Portal rendering (avoid DOM/Z-index conflicts) ## Implementation - Extend `ChatbotSchema` with floating config fields - Add `FloatingChatbotProvider` context for global state and external control - New components: `FloatingChatbot`, `FloatingChatbotPanel`, `FloatingChatbotTrigger`, provider/hook - Console shell integration for metadata-aware prompts - Storybook stories, Vitest tests, full docs ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] User can toggle chatbot from any page via FAB - [ ] Panel is accessible, responsive, and theme-compliant - [ ] All existing chatbot features preserved - [ ] Easy to configure via schema - [ ] Tests and documentation updated --- See detailed architectural proposal in engineering notes and reference screenshot above.
